title: Replay the chat
caption: The summer party chat at step 9, with its timeline. The window itself is tucked away until you ask for it.

readme.heading: Read me
readme.shows: A chat with an AI assistant, played step by step. The Budget message is pinned, and only the conversation and its timeline are on screen.
readme.tryit: Hover or drag the timeline to replay earlier steps. Switch on the context window with the Show chips. Press Escape to unpin the Budget message.
readme.notice: Hovering only previews: the chat shows the earlier messages, and when you leave it returns to step 9.
